# smplkit_service (Resource)

A smplkit service — a backend application or microservice in the customer's stack that contexts can be evaluated against. The `id` is caller-supplied and doubles as the import id; updates are full-replace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "smplkit_service" "user_service" {
  id   = "user_service"
  name = "User Service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The service key (e.g. `user_service`). Caller-supplied at create. Use this same value as the `terraform import` identifier.
- `name` (String) Display name shown in the smplkit console.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp set by the server when the service was created.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp set by the server on every write. Recomputed on every apply, so plans involving updates show this as `(known after apply)`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import smplkit_service.user_service user_service
```
